_readme: soq_rules.json - persistent rules data for tools/soq_gate.py, curated from MEMORIES.md.
Update this file whenever MEMORIES gains a new banned claim or a newly verified quantifiable.
banned_claims: hard FAIL. 'allow_near' is a regex; a hit is excused only if it falls inside an allow_near match.
verified_numbers: a digit number in the SOQ must appear in the same sentence as one of its context terms.
Known value + wrong context = FAIL (the '70 clients' drift class). Unknown number = WARN.
number_exempt: regex spans whose digits are never treated as quantifiables (JC numbers, versions, years).
confession_patterns / buzzwords / style: WARN-level. story_anchors feed the cross-answer double-spend check.
All patterns are Python re, matched case-insensitively unless noted.
